source: Official Government Scheme Guidelines & Open Data Portal

schemes.benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (linked with mobile number)
Proof of Cultivable Land Ownership (Khasra/Khatauni / Bhu-Naksha)
Active Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar NPCI seeded)
Valid Mobile Number for OTP verification

schemes.benefits_summary: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹10 Lakhs (Shishu: up to ₹50,000, Kishore: ₹50k to ₹5L, Tarun: ₹5L to ₹10L).
required_documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Address Proof (Utility Bill / Ration Card / Aadhaar)
Business Proof / Registration Certificate / Trade License
Bank Account Statement (Last 6 months)
2 Passport Size Photographs

schemes.target_audience: Unorganized sector workers looking for guaranteed pension
schemes.benefits_summary: Guaranteed monthly pension between ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after reaching age 60.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Savings Bank Account Passbook (Auto-debit mandate required)
Active Mobile Number

schemes.target_audience: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child aged under 10 years
schemes.benefits_summary: High interest rate government savings scheme with EEE tax exemption for higher education & marriage.
required_documents: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
Aadhaar Card of Parent / Legal Guardian
PAN Card of Parent / Legal Guardian
Address Proof & Passport size photos of Guardian

schemes.name_en: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.target_audience: Poor and vulnerable families listed under SECC database / Ayushman card holders
schemes.benefits_summary: Free health coverage of up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospital care.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / Ayushman Family ID
Income Certificate or SECC verification document
Active Mobile Number
